scope: Trial-only aggregate findings; full case-specific website synthesis is not redistributed here.
cohort: All 28 available baseline paired-RNA trial subjects.
primary_endpoint: Confirmed CR/PR or stable disease maintained at least six months; five versus 23.
secondary_endpoint: Objective response, two versus 26, separate exploratory four-test BH family.
findings: None of the four prespecified TGF-beta/fibroblast/ECM mean-rank programs showed a significant primary association after four-test BH correction; every primary q=0.521041921041921.
All 24 aggregate endpoint/scoring rows and 72 exact unstratified/stratified tests were independently reproduced. No prespecified sensitivity produced a nominal P<0.05.
The analysis does not validate high archival pathway expression as a vactosertib-selection biomarker and does not rule out benefit.
interpretation_limits: Small event counts and no untreated comparator prevent treatment-effect prediction or a personal response estimate.
Archival sampling, unknown biopsy organ, clinical confounding and unequal coding depth limit interpretation.
Native admission identified 24 ISR and four weak-directionality IU libraries; 11 of 28 had retained-pair transcript mapping below20%.
